title: DSL corpus manifest
description: Per-DSL manifest that lets the Ralph builder step map an extension to its documentation/example corpus. See CORPUS_REQUIREMENTS.md.

name.description: Grammar name; matches tools/dslc/grammars/<name>.py once built.

extensions.description: File extensions this DSL owns, leading dot included (e.g. ".flags").

version.description: Corpus version. Bump when spec/examples change so the loop can detect stale generated assets.

spec.description: Path (relative to the manifest) to the authoritative grammar/spec document.

mistakes.description: Path to the common-mistakes fault catalogue (defines the rule-ids).

examples_good.description: Directory (trailing slash) of valid, isolate-compilable examples.

examples_bad.description: OPTIONAL. Directory (trailing slash) of hand-authored edge-case invalid examples, each with a sibling .expect sidecar. Normally the bad set is DERIVED by the loop via per-rule-id mutation of the good examples (see CORPUS_REQUIREMENTS.md §4) rather than shipped in the corpus.
